name: Unbox
description: The second clip is tossed in folded up as an open card box, lands with a bounce, then its walls fall open flat until it covers the frame. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: depth
params.description: Height of the walls, as a part of the shorter side

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the faces darken, and their shadows

params.name: paper
params.description: Color of the back of the card
